description: Volatile release-tracked facts (founding doc section 13) as v1.state.* atoms with _dt_2026_08_30 suffixes. Each payload names the condition that obsoletes it; on change: mint a new dated state atom + supersedes edge + tombstone the old one in the same checkpoint. Hub: hub_sf_volatile.

atoms.payload: [V-O, as of 2026-08-30] Base lightning-* components run in SYNTHETIC shadow DOM; mixed shadow mode is still Beta and does not cover base components. OBSOLETED WHEN: a release note announces native shadow for base components or synthetic-shadow retirement — that flip instantly breaks XPath-on-LEX accidents and scope-attribute assumptions; tombstone this atom, mint the successor, and re-audit every locator suite for XPath/structure remnants.

[V-O, verified May 2026] frontdoor.jsp?sid= still works; Salesforce recommends the single-use UI Bridge (singleaccess) for new implementations; no dated retirement announced. OBSOLETED WHEN: a retirement date is announced or sid= injection starts failing — then move all auth builders to UI Bridge and tombstone this atom.

[V-O, as of 2026-08-30] LWS is default in new orgs but automatic enablement of older orgs was postponed — the fleet is mixed, so the org's LWS toggle must be pinned and recorded as a test-environment variable per target org. OBSOLETED WHEN: Salesforce completes auto-enablement (release note) — then LWS can be assumed everywhere and this atom tombstoned.

[V-O, as of 2026-08-30] Boxcar disablement + HTTP/2 rollout are actively changing /aura network signatures release-over-release. Any waitForResponse URL/shape assumption needs re-verification each seasonal release. OBSOLETED WHEN: the performance program stabilizes (no network-shape items in two consecutive release notes) — then relax to normal release vigilance.

[V-M, as of 2026-08-30] SLDS 2 ('Cosmos' theme) goes GA Winter '26: same slds-* class names, different computed styles, plus dark mode — visual baselines become theme-dependent. OBSOLETED WHEN: GA lands and target orgs adopt it — then re-baseline all visual tests per theme, verify slds-* state-marker classes still render, and supersede this atom with the post-GA state.

[S, as of 2026-08-30] The Salesforce CDN is migrating to Cloudflare during 2026 — relevant to CI egress allowlists and portal cache behavior (stale-LWC symptoms may shift). OBSOLETED WHEN: migration completes or is confirmed abandoned — update CI allowlist guidance and tombstone.

[V-O, behavior since Aug 2025] sf org open --url-only URLs are single-use and expire in 60 seconds — consume immediately in the setup project, persist the session via storageState, never cache or share the URL across workers. OBSOLETED WHEN: forcedotcom/cli release notes change the lifetime/reuse behavior — update auth builders and supersede.

[V-O, Aug 2026] Toolchain version pins: Playwright ~1.6x, jsforce 3.10.x, Serenity/JS 3.41.x, UTAM salesforce-pageobjects npm v12. OBSOLETED BY: any major-version bump — re-verify API assumptions (Playwright locator engine + auth/storageState APIs, jsforce typings) and supersede with a new dated pin atom rather than editing this one.

[S, as of 2026-08-30] Experience Delivery (Beta) is discontinued effective Winter '27 — do not build portal test infrastructure or performance assumptions on it. OBSOLETED WHEN: Winter '27 ships and the discontinuation is final — the claim becomes plain history; tombstone the state atom.
